body:
The host runs ghostty and umbriel (a tiling WM with a CLI-over-IPC, scriptable with bash/python/jq); sway and niri are broadly compatible alternatives. Neither is in the jail.

So 'open a window attached to session X' is umbriel's verb, not zmux's, and 'make a terminal that looks right' is ghostty's. zmux supplies the session name and the attach argv; the WM supplies the window. That is the whole window-management story, and it is why a TUI sidebar would be duplicating a tiling WM.
title: umbriel and ghostty already own windows
